newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on soybean gains.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on soybean gains.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Thursday, shadowing sharp gains in soybeans, pit sources said.

Rice had opened lower in reaction to lackluster USDA weekly export sales data. USDA on Thursday said there were 6,000 tonnes of rice exported, down 70 percent from the previous week and the four-week average.
"Export sales weren't particularly good," a trader said. "We broke early on very light volume but then Term (Commodities) came in to buy it, about 40 lots in the September and January."
Pit sources said local traders were reluctant to sell given the strong gains in soybeans.
Rice ended 11 to 9-1/2 cents per cwt with September up 9-1/2 at $9.69-1/2. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 200 lots, compared with Wednesday's actual volume of 140.
